title: Autonomous Synthesis: Resistance Mechanisms to KRAS G12C Direct Inhibitors in NSCLC
query: KRAS G12C inhibitor resistance mechanisms in NSCLC adagrasib sotorasib
summary_md:
### Executive Synthesis: KRAS G12C Inhibitor Resistance

Covalent switch-II pocket inhibitors (Adagrasib [PMID:33827083] and Sotorasib [PMID:34033782]) demonstrate confirmed objective response rates of **37.1% to 43.0%** in pretreated KRAS G12C-mutant non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

#### Key Resistance Pathways Identified:
1. **On-Target Secondary Mutations**: Emergence of KRAS Y96D, Y96C, R68S, and switch-II binding pocket alterations preventing covalent electrophilic binding [PMID:35134789].
2. **Off-Target Bypass Signaling**: Parallel receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) amplifications including MET, EGFR, and HER2 [PMID:33827083].
3. **Downstream Feedback Re-activation**: Rapid SOS1/SHP2-mediated GTP reloading of wild-type and mutated RAS alleles [PMID:35134789].

#### Clinical Recommendation:
Combination regimens coupling covalent KRAS G12C inhibitors with SHP2 inhibitors (e.g. TNO155) or pan-ERBB inhibitors are strongly recommended to circumvent adaptive feedback loops.

title: Systematic Review: Anti-Amyloid Monoclonal Antibodies in Early Alzheimer's Disease
query: Anti-amyloid monoclonal antibodies lecanemab donanemab early Alzheimer clinical trials CDR-SB
summary_md:
### Executive Synthesis: Disease-Modifying Amyloid Therapeutics

Phase 3 randomized controlled trials of protofibril/plaque-targeting monoclonal antibodies (**Lecanemab** [PMID:36450123] and **Donanemab** [PMID:37464012]) provide conclusive Level 1b clinical evidence that robust amyloid plaque clearance slows cognitive and functional decline in early Alzheimer's disease.

#### Comparative Efficacy & Safety:
- **Lecanemab (Clarity AD)**: Slowed 18-month cognitive decline by 27% on CDR-SB (difference -0.45, P<0.001) with 12.6% ARIA-E incidence [PMID:36450123].
- **Donanemab (TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 2)**: Slowed clinical decline by 35.1% on iADRS at 76 weeks in low/medium tau subgroups; achieved plaque clearance in 80% of patients [PMID:37464012].

#### Safety Monitoring:
Routine baseline and serial MRI surveillance (weeks 5, 9, 14) is mandatory to monitor asymptomatic and symptomatic ARIA-E/ARIA-H, especially in APOE-epsilon4 homozygotes.

title: Evidence Synthesis: Dual GIP/GLP-1 Receptor Agonism vs GLP-1 Mono-Agonism in Cardiometabolic Disease
query: Tirzepatide semaglutide cardiovascular outcomes weight loss RCT
summary_md:
### Executive Synthesis: Incretin Therapeutics & Cardiovascular Protection

High-dose incretin receptor agonists represent a paradigm shift in obesity and cardiovascular disease management:

1. **SURMOUNT-1 (Tirzepatide)**: Achieved unprecedented mean weight reduction of **-20.9%** (-23.6 kg) at 72 weeks with robust improvements in blood pressure and lipid profiles [PMID:36912389].
2. **SELECT Trial (Semaglutide 2.4 mg)**: Established a **20% risk reduction in Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events (MACE)** (HR 0.80, P<0.001) in 17,604 patients with overweight/obesity and established CVD without diabetes [PMID:37590123].
